summary: Full test of Caregiver Sync delete/restore flows. All 11 pytest backend tests passed (patients CRUD, entries CRUD, delete+restore, bulk-delete, stats, collection wipe, full wipe). Frontend UI tested end-to-end via Playwright: patient creation, opening detail, adding 3 entries (vital/medication/symptom), single-entry delete with Undo (restore works), delete without undo (permanent after 5s), bulk delete by kind, patient delete + Undo, settings stats, clear entries collection, and total wipe. All flows work as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown'); prefer lifespan handlers.
restore_patient/restore_entry accept a raw dict without Pydantic validation; a malicious/malformed payload could insert arbitrary fields. Consider validating with Patient/Entry models.
restore_patient does not check for duplicate id — calling restore twice would insert two docs with same id. Consider upsert or 409 on existing id.
list_patients / list_entries hard-coded to_list(1000/10000) with no pagination; fine for MVP but flag for scale.
CORS allow_origins default '*' with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per spec; browsers ignore credentials with '*'. OK since no auth is used.
Frontend App.js (~700 lines) mixes 4 page components; could be split into files for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Tests wipe DB before each backend test; frontend test also wipes via /api/data/wipe. No persistent seed left behind (final wipe leaves DB empty).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_caregiver_api.py auto-wipes DB per test via autouse fixture. UI has full data-testid coverage: add-patient-btn, save-patient-btn, patient-card-{id}, delete-patient-{id}-btn/-confirm/-cancel/-dialog, open-patient-{id}, entry-kind-select, entry-label-input, entry-value-input, entry-unit-input, add-entry-btn, entry-{id}, delete-entry-{id}-btn/-confirm, bulk-delete-{kind}-btn/-confirm, settings-link, clear-entries-btn/-confirm, clear-patients-btn/-confirm, wipe-all-btn/-confirm. Sonner Undo action button has no testid — locate via 'button:has-text("Annulla"):not([data-testid])' or '[data-sonner-toast] button'. Note: [data-testid^="entry-"] also matches form inputs (entry-label-input etc.), so filter accordingly when counting rows.
rca of the issue: No bugs. Initial run had a false-positive assertion because selector [data-testid^="entry-"] matched 4 form inputs in addition to entry rows. Fixed in second run.
